label: Life expectancy at birth

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

target_rationale: Fixed published analytical benchmark from Fanning et al. Table 1 (2021 online / 2022 issue), held invariant for this partial adaptation; not an Argentine statutory target or proof that every resident has adequate provision.
comparability_notes: UN population estimates; not healthy life expectancy. Historical revisions retained in this single WDI vintage.

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

label: Access to electricity

geography.name: Argentina

comparability_notes: WDI/Tracking SDG7 estimates. Basic access is not affordability, reliability, or clean cooking. The 2024 decline is retained and must not automatically be attributed to policy.

label: Individuals using the Internet

geography.name: Argentina

geography.name: Argentina

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

geography.name: Argentina

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

label: PM2.5 mean annual population-weighted exposure

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

geography.name: Argentina

label: Freshwater withdrawal relative to available resources

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

comparability_notes: FAO AQUASTAT national SDG6.4.2 aggregate. Identical source values 2013–2022 do not establish annual unchanged local water stress; masks seasonal/subnational scarcity and is not consumption footprint.

label: Labour force employed (100 − unemployment)

geography.name: Argentina
geography.coverage: National territory/population, according to each producer definition.

target_rationale: Fixed published analytical benchmark from Fanning et al. Table 1 (2021 online / 2022 issue), held invariant for this partial adaptation; not an Argentine statutory target or proof that every resident has adequate provision.
comparability_notes: Derived 100 minus ILO-modelled unemployed share; excludes people outside the labour force and does not measure job quality, hours, or informality.

label: Gini index, urban second-semester survey

geography.name: Argentina: urban income survey
geography.coverage: World Bank PIP reporting_level=urban; EPHC-S2 second-semester income surveys. Not a nationally representative rural+urban distribution.

comparability_notes: WDI reporting year is tied to EPHC-S2 in PIP, not an annual-average distribution. WDI rounded Gini retained; PIP is used to establish coverage/period. 2015 is missing and 2013–2015 INDEC statistics carry official reservations.

comparability_notes: WDI reporting year is tied to EPHC-S2 in PIP, not an annual-average distribution. WDI rounded Gini retained; PIP is used to establish coverage/period. 2015 is missing and 2013–2015 INDEC statistics carry official reservations.

label: People below the national income poverty line, EPH urban sample

geography.name: Argentina: EPH urban survey
geography.coverage: 31 urban agglomerations; not the whole national population. H2 2019 excludes Gran Resistencia; H2 2020 excludes Ushuaia–Rio Grande.

comparability_notes: Monetary household-basket poverty/indigence; survey estimates, not a multidimensional poverty measure. Comparable historical publication restarts H2 2016; H2 2023 overlaps 21 days of Milei administration. Latest H1 2026 is provisional.
